About.bioTitle: I build software with curiosity, care, and purpose.
About.bio: I'm Luis Sebastián Díaz, a fifth-semester Software Engineering student in Pasto. I enjoy turning real needs into clear, functional digital products, from web interfaces to ESP32-connected solutions. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn, refine the details, and build technology that is genuinely useful to people.

descriptions.ecoplaza-iot-desktop: Cross-platform desktop software for registering, monitoring and managing recyclable waste, with ESP32 telemetry and persistence in Supabase/PostgreSQL.
descriptions.visual-trace-mobile: Mobile application for documenting the state of spaces or objects with before-and-after photographs, private storage and a Supabase backend.
descriptions.ridewake-platform: Application for Xiaomi Smart Band 7 developed with Zepp OS. Allows selecting destinations, simulating routes, and estimating arrival time using a Machine Learning model, featuring proximity alerts. Includes an interactive web demo.
descriptions.lullaby-3d-game: Collaborative 3D psychological-horror roguelike in which Noah moves through a nightmare of toys and memories transformed into creatures.
descriptions.legado-de-valientes: Turn-based RPG for raising, training and battling fantasy pets, with Phaser combat and a Spring Boot REST API connected to MongoDB.
descriptions.music-player: Web music player with local playlist management, audio playback, search, album and playlist views, and light and dark themes.
